unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 4 - Plan and Draft - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Three pictures held all term: flag (claim), magnifier (prove), megaphone (sell). Weeks 1-5 final piece: a published persuasive text on an issue from The Last Bear.

lessons.title: Choose Your Fight
lessons.focus: Choose the issue, audience and form for the big piece and plan three reasons. Critical feature: the audience decides the language. Retrieves: Week 1 issues and Week 2 evidence.

lessons.title: Open Strong
lessons.focus: Draft the introduction: hook, context, position, preview. Critical feature: by the end of the introduction the reader knows exactly what you want. Retrieves: Week 3 hooks.

lessons.title: Build Your Body
lessons.focus: Draft body paragraphs with a topic sentence that leads and linking words that guide. Critical feature: the first sentence of a paragraph tells the reader its claim. Retrieves: Week 2 claim-prove-sell paragraph.

lessons.title: Answer Back and Finish Strong
lessons.focus: Draft the rebuttal and a conclusion with a call to action. Critical feature: a conclusion tells the reader what to do now. Retrieves: Week 1 rebuttal.
